title: process_update receipt suppressed for blocked senders without documentation
description: process_update (message.rs lines 507-521) silently skips the receipt enqueue when is_permitted returns false — i.e., when the original sender is blocked. This means marking a blocked contact's message as read never sends them a receipt. That policy may be intentional (blocked contacts shouldn't get any feedback) but it is not documented anywhere in the code comments or CLAUDE.md. A future maintainer editing the receipt path could change this behaviour without realising it has policy implications. Add a comment explaining the deliberate policy: receipts are intentionally withheld from blocked senders.
